title: Bear Spray
description: Grizzlies ended 38.1% of your runs: a new weapon that blasts an orange cone of pepper spray ahead of you, and every bear caught in it stops, turns and runs for two seconds.

title: God Candle
description: A rare green god candle drops on the chart; grab it and a giant green candle rips up through the screen and liquidates every bear in view.

title: The Whale
description: A third character: a huge, slow whale with 150 HP who starts with Belly Flop, a splash that knocks every bear around it off the screen.
